annotations.title: x402 precheck: should my agent pay this endpoint?

description: [Kyreos, 0.002 USDC per call via x402 on Base] Give it an x402 URL. It reads the live 402 envelope, payTo, price, network and asset, then checks the payee's settlement history in a chain-stamped index (payer count and last settlement are host-level). Returns PAY or a reason not to. 0.002 USDC, a fifth of the 0.01 endpoint-lint checks, plus chain proof. Input: ?url=https://host/paid-route. HTTP: GET https://store.agentexchange.work/w/x402-precheck?q=... Call once without x_payment to get the x402 payment terms (0.002 USDC); call again with x_payment (the signed x402 payment) to get the result.

x_payment.description: base64 x402 payment payload for the terms returned on the first call (0.002 USDC on Base)
